premises.text: E-commerce clothing returns are driven by fit problems that require body shape, not size alone
premises.evidence_span: The problem with returns is more than just a size or a measurement issue. The solution must include shape

premises.text: Teaching designers only hourglass and rectangle shapes excludes half of women from the design table
premises.evidence_span: This single decision takes half of women off of the design table

premises.text: Shape filter uses AI classification of assortments plus a UI capturing shopper shape and proportion to recommend garments
premises.evidence_span: these together comprise the shape filter technology

premises.text: Unlike size-only rivals, recommendations show how clothes will look and narrow the assortment to what fits
premises.evidence_span: they will tell you what size to buy, but they fail to tell you how you will look in those clothes. They won't give you a subset to make your shopping easier

premises.text: Retailers pay an annual contract with upfront fee and percentage of sales; system fits inventory management
premises.evidence_span: Our enterprise implementation fits easily into our customers' inventory management system. We have an annual contract with an upfront fee and a percentage of sales

domains.name: Enterprise fee and share of sales

value.text: Help women shop with confidence by recommending clothes that match body shape and proportion
value.evidence_span: making her shopping a whole lot easier

secondary_value.text: Improve retail economics by increasing sales and decreasing returns
secondary_value.evidence_span: Savitude does improve our retail economics

causal_links.evidence_span: one third of clothing be returned because it doesn't fit
recommendations on clothing for an individual body shape and proportion

notes: Competitive differentiation kept as part of product theory (how shape filter creates value vs TrueFit). Patent-pending knowledge base folded into shape filter. Accessories roadmap not coded as premise. Founder credentials excluded.
